semantics: Per-observation bbox bottom-centre ground hit versus object truth N/E; not flight-policy counterfactual.

association.method: maximum image-space IoU to visible scenario object bbox; no ground matching
association.fallback_limitation: Projected boxes ignore rendered occlusion; ambiguous overlapping boxes can misassociate.

stored_ground_ne_equivalence.limitation: Recorded bboxes may be rounded; ground_ne may preserve unrounded or smoothed tracks. Differences are not compatibility failures.
